title: Universal Life Insurance Policy Accounting Note: Refund of the Unearned Monthly Deduction on Surrender
content:
On the full surrender of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy, part of the latest monthly deduction may be refunded as unearned. The unearned deduction refund is added to the value the surrender releases, both in the cash surrender value and in the taxable amount.

**Rule.** The refund follows the days from the latest monthly anniversary in the deduction history to the surrender's effective date, on a thirty-day month:

| Days from the latest monthly anniversary to the effective date | Unearned deduction refund |
|---|---|
| 1 to 15 | The whole latest monthly deduction, for the unused days of the thirty: the deduction times thirty less the days, divided by thirty |
| 16 to 29 | Only the cost of insurance part of the latest monthly deduction, for the unused days of the thirty |
| 0, or 30 or more | Nothing |

The latest monthly deduction and its cost of insurance part are read from the most recent monthly deduction entry in the activity history.

**Worked figures (hypothetical; latest monthly deduction $420.00, of which cost of insurance $300.00).**

| Days | Basis | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | $420.00 times 18 thirtieths | $252.00 |
| 15 | $420.00 times 15 thirtieths | $210.00 |
| 16 | $300.00 times 14 thirtieths | $140.00 |
| 20 | $300.00 times 10 thirtieths | $100.00 |
| 0 | none | nothing |

The refund is not rounded on its own.
